title: Neural networks and physical systems with emergent collective computational abilities
summary: J. J. Hopfield published "Neural networks and physical systems with emergent collective computational abilities" in Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences. The paper describes a neural-network model whose collective dynamics provide content-addressable memory and uses asynchronous parallel processing for state evolution.
significance: A documented neural-network milestone for content-addressable memory and collective computation, recorded from the publisher DOI record and Caltech's institutional archival record.
